ym_instance.label: Yandex Music source
ym_instance.description: Borrow OAuth credentials from a linked Yandex Music provider instance, or use your own credentials (QR-scan login or manual token paste). Per-instance own credentials let you bind separate players to separate Yandex accounts without sharing tokens with a Yandex Music provider.

remember_session.label: Remember session (auto-refresh token)
remember_session.description: Store a long-lived session token (x_token) alongside the music token so this plugin can refresh on its own when the token expires. Disable to keep only the short-lived music token (re-QR required on expiry).

mass_player_id.label: [%key:common::config_entries::mass_player_id::label%]
mass_player_id.description: The Music Assistant player connected to this Ynison plugin. When playback is directed to this device in the Yandex Music app, the audio will play on the selected player.

allow_player_switch.label: Allow manual player switching
allow_player_switch.description: When enabled, you can select this plugin as a source on any player to switch playback to that player. When disabled, playback is fixed to the configured default player.

output_sample_rate.label: Output sample rate
output_sample_rate.description: Sample rate for PCM output to the player. 'Auto' selects 44.1 kHz for lossy or 48 kHz for lossless sources.

output_bit_depth.label: Output bit depth
output_bit_depth.description: Bit depth for PCM output to the player. 'Auto' selects 16-bit for lossy or 24-bit for lossless sources.

user.title: Yandex Music account
user.description: Choose the Yandex Music account and the target player.

scan_qr.title: Scan to sign in
scan_qr.description: Scan the QR code with the Yandex app and confirm the login. A fresh code is shown automatically if it expires.
scan_qr.progress_text: Waiting for you to scan and confirm in the Yandex app...

abort.no_players: No players are available yet. Add a player to Music Assistant first, then try again.

errors.no_music_token: Login succeeded but Yandex returned no music token. Please try again.
errors.no_connected_player: No connected Music Assistant player is configured. Run the setup again to select one.

manifest.description: Makes a Music Assistant player appear as a device in the Yandex Music app via the Ynison protocol.
